development_authorization: User approved DCR-003 research only; P02 stays READY_FOR_REVIEW, formal scoring scope pending.
data_rule: All signed E1 Train and Validation partitions, all HMB joint-valid geometry ticks. Count invalid and unknown separately. Fit Train once, hash freeze the fitted candidates before reading Validation geometry.
cohort_rule: Use all 38 frozen original planned identities (32 roots, 6 F1 tails). Replay original full and fixed-hand outcomes as historical evidence. Use the three original recorded initializations on M0 and seeds by the same algorithm on candidate targets. Do not replace ineligible or failed rows.

M1.loss: Train-only equal-root-weight radial excess squared plus 0.018 times home-wrist distance squared and weak transform regularization. Yaw and translation shared, scale 1. Preserve original fixed wrist mounting unless separate dated calibration exists.

M2.trigger: Run only if M1 Train bound >3 mm fraction remains above 0.02 on all valid Train ticks.
M2.loss: Same as M1 with additional scale penalty and common wrist centroid pivot. Scale acts only on inter-wrist spacings and common wrist translation, not on local bone lengths.

functional.comparison: Original hard-switch vs continuous smoothstep. Compare every within-segment consecutive tick, label velocities as proxy. Include up to one earliest valid entry and exit per split and side for constrained legal FK checks.
